name: hey-my-buddy
description: Local dsh delegation through the uv-managed Buddy CLI: a transactional Python blackboard over C-Two owns tasks, results and events, independent workers execute through dsh/command/external adapters, and there is no MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate work to local dsh via the Buddy CLI.
interface.longDescription: Delegate bounded dsh tasks through a uv-managed Buddy CLI backed by a transactional Python blackboard over C-Two. Independent workers claim queued tasks and execute them through dsh, command or caller-owned external adapters. One `buddy run` stays connected until the run finishes, `buddy await` keeps waiting on the same run, `buddy inquire` asks the live agent a correlated question, and results stay durable and inspectable. Background follow-up uses an explicit official App heartbeat that calls the same CLI - there is no MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a bounded task to my local dsh.
